First, you must revive five Yemma trees. Then the path to the sprite's tree will open!

Get a move on, or else the fairies will be fairy annoyed! Hah!

383.original: So, you wanna go back to the Other World map?

386.original: You're going back to Snake Way? How sssssneaky of you! Hah!

388.original: A small garage. Does it ever even rain in this world?

389.original: A stylish sedan. King Kai uses this to tool around the road, apparently.

390.original: An old-fashioned well. Apparently there's ground water to be had in this world.

394.original: Ook ook! Ook ook ook ook ook!

398.original:
That planet Earth seems to have nothing but terrible things happen to it.

For better or for worse, you certainly wouldn't be bored living there.

399.original:
I've had enough of King Kai's stupid puns.

Put up with that for a few centuries, and you'd be pretty drained, too...

400.original: This table has a smaller table placed on top of it.

401.original:
The Path of a Punmaster, Enrich Your Life with Puns, Love and Punnery...

The shelf's book selection is, to say the least, a bit skewed.

402.original:
You oughta be strong enough by now... I'll give you permission to venture outside.

But you're your own man now. No visiting anyplace that'll spoil you like before. Got it?

405.original: It's a gigantic flower. The scent is just as overpowering...

406.original: A statue of Mutaito, teacher of Master Roshi and Master Shen, sits here.

407.original: If we go any further, there won't be any turning back. You ready?

408.original: There's no turning back now. Let's keep going.

410.original: You people sure are strong... I don't know what I'd do without you.

411.original: We're almost at the top... Be careful.

412.original: The giant machine keep on whirring, even after its owner has disappeared.

413.original: Tea bottles and snack food are strewn across the table.

414.original: The bridge has collapsed. You can see a river flowing far down below.

415.original: There's no turning back beyond this point. You sure about this?

416.original: I'm sorry, Goku... You're the only guy we can rely on. Are you leaving?

419.original: It's up to you, Goku. Try not to get yourself killed.

420.original: I think I've got a chance to win this time.

422.original: Piccolo... I guess you saved Gohan's life. I swear I'll get revenge for you!

423.original:
Huh...looks like this robot man's battery ran out.

Wonder if there's a spare battery somewhere in the ruins?

424.original: You have no more reason to be here. Walk onward and search for your future.

425.original: You're not exactly sure what this device is used for.

426.original:
I don't even have the energy to destroy this...

I wish I could see Piccolo...

427.original:
Yamcha! Is your training going well?

I forgot to give you this earlier! Go ahead, take it!

428.original: Yamcha! I believe in you, okay? I know you can beat up those Saiyans for us!

430.original: I promise I'll protect your home, Yamcha! Just focus on your training!

431.original:
Whoahh! T-this is Yamcha's place!

I'm protecting his home from intruders, and I... I'm not gonna let you beat me!

432.original: I'll be cheering you on right here! Hang in there, everybody!

433.original: A slender business suit hangs here among the training outfits.

434.original: The hanging scroll is written with characters too complex for you to read.

435.original:
I think this is about how you have to use heavy weights to refine your body and stuff...

Y-you know, don't get lazy with your training, that sort of thing!

436.original: Refreshing cooking smells emanate from the pot.

439.original:
Notice: Dragon Rock, home to monsters, due east.

Trespassing and treasure hunting is highly discouraged.

442.original: A portrait of Pilaf... not very flattering.

443.original: A TV monitor. Nothing's being displayed right now.

444.original: A large, ponderous machine. You don't know what it's used for.

446.original: There's some kind of button here. Push it?

447.original: A ping-pong table is set up here.

448.original: Cards and a game board lie here, abandoned in the middle of play.

449.original: A large dragon sculpture. The owner of this place must like dragons.

450.original: Colorful, expensive-looking vases are lined up here.

451.original: A glass piece of some sort. You don't know what it's used for.

452.original: A full-sized pinball machine. It appears to have seen heavy use.

453.original: A large lotus flower sits in the middle of the pond, emitting a mystical light.

454.original: The two falling stars were omens of disaster. Something else is going to happen soon.

455.original: Thank you for coming. We are the people that guard the sacred land.

456.original: I heard something terrible happened to East City! What was it, I wonder?

457.original:
They say there's a really neat cat that lives at the top of Korin Tower!

I'm gonna climb up there someday and catch it!

458.original: I wonder if the shooting stars surprised the cat in Korin Tower, too.

459.original: There's no way a cat could live so high up there! I mean, it'd fall off!

462.original: Hey! You still okay?! East City exploded, so I thought you were dead, too!

463.original: I hear East City exploded! Big surprise! Did that temple blow up, too?

464.original: Oh! You! I still train to keep you from beating me! Hi-yahh!

465.original: People here are very nice! I can train in peace! Hi-yahh!

466.original: The sky was bright red over in the east! What was that...?!

467.original:
The whole world is in a panic.

Times like these are when you have to relax and look at the big picture.

You must understand what is really happening

468.original: We felt the aftershock of the explosion at the East City.Korin Tower was shaking termendously.

469.original: Inside this village is Korin Tower, a structure so high that they say it reaches the sky.

470.original: Bora told me to calm down, but I can't... I feel like something terrible's going to happen.

471.original:
Bora, the sole protector of the village, was killed by the military.

But this boy came to save his life with his mysterious power.

472.original: Two falling stars... I just know something is about to unfold for us all.

473.original: This land once fell under attack by a group calling themselves the Red Ribbon Army.

474.original: You know what? Korin Tower swayed a whole bunch! I was afraid it was gonna fall down!

475.original: You just got down from that tower, right? What's it like in there?!

477.original: Mankind has angered the gods... That was a bolt of lightning from the deities themselves.

478.original: The river source inside the cave is a sacred place. No one is allowed near it.

479.original: Hey... is what happened to East City gonna happen to the rest of the world, too?

480.original: Upa is so cool! I can't believe how strong he is!

481.original:
There's no point falling into panic at a time like this.

We just have to accept our fate when it arrives.

482.original: This is the Chief's tent. You can go inside, but please don't make a mess.

483.original:
Did you think Speed just determines who attacks first in battle?

Well, it's more than that! Higher speed lets you evade enemy attacks more often! Cool, huh?

486.original: A statue of Korin, complete with a rather cute tail.

487.original: A statue of Korin. His smiling face beams across town.

488.original: I can't believe East City exploded... I've never seen such an angry-looking sky.

489.original:
This is the Sacred Land of Korin.

A group has gathered here and formed a village, following the beliefs of Bora's tribe.

490.original: Food gathered from the forest rests on the counter.

491.original:
It seems people are running from their homes after hearing about East City.

Where can they run, though? As long as we're on Earth, we all share the same fate.

492.original: We don't get guests very often. If you think Korin Tower is a tourist spot, you're mistaken.

493.original: A sharp odor wafts out of the pot. There must be some kind of medicine inside.

494.original:
You can build up your body all you want, but if your heart is not just as solid...

Then you'll be unable to act when the time calls for it. It's a difficult sort of balance.

495.original:
If you climb the tower, the hermit who lives up top will give you sacred water.

Drink it, and your power will be multiplied countless times.

496.original: The altar is draped with an intricately-designed cloth.

497.original: There is a depression in the ground. Do you want to try stepping on it?

500.original: Princess Snake's room is on the other side.

501.original: There is Princess Snake's chair... but no Princess Snake.

502.original:
It sounds like he went off to a power source as strong as my own...

Did he mean... Goku?!!

I'd better go to Master Roshi and see what's up...

But who is this Kakarot?

503.original:
When you raise your Skill parameter, you can fire off beams and stuff! Cool, huh?

What kind of waves? Well, I don't know! Microwaves? Cosmic waves?

...Oh, no, I hope it's not cosmic waves! I'm scared of those! Ahhhhh!!

504.original: Not even Fortuneteller Baba can predict the future this time... I hope Earth turns out all right.

505.original: Admission is free for all of you. Please, come on in.

506.original: Ah, a visitor... heh heh heh. Please, come right in.

507.original: You hear about East City?! They say space aliens blew it up! How scary!

508.original: You're all too strong! Just go visit Baba, okay? You don't have to do any fighting!

509.original: Fortuneteller Baba always looks forward to new challengers.

511.original: I've been lying here this whole time, so I'm starting to get a little sleepy...

513.original: Hey, I think this guy's just pretending to be knocked out. Let's try kicking him.

514.original: My blood's been sucked... I feel faint. When am I ever gonna win here?

515.original: That's not fair! You can't fight when you're invisible!

519.original: Earth is dangerous enough as is... now someone's actively trying to destroy it.

520.original: P-P-Piccolo! What do you want?! You here to beat up a poor old woman?!

521.original: What do you want? You guys are too strong for me. I'll tell your fortunes without a fight.

525.original: I'd be happy to guide you to the Other World. Would you like to pay it a visit...?

526.original:
This giant crystal ball emits a mystical light.

If you look closely, you can see something writhing around inside.

527.original:
An eerie mask has been hung on the wall.

It's warm to the touch, almost as if it's alive.

528.original: A golden coffin shines coldly, covered by a gravestone-like object.

529.original: I can bring the dead back from the Other World for a short time. Who would you like to resurrect?

532.original: You people are hopeless without me. I suppose I can help you out for a little bit.

534.original: But Piccolo is right beside you! I don't appreciate being made fun of, you!

536.original: Ha hahh! I'm ready and rarin' to go!

538.original: But Yamcha is right beside you! Didn't you notice him?

540.original: Thanks, man. Time to kick up a little dust!

542.original: But Tien is right beside you! Quit being silly with me!

543.original: Oh, man... I let myself go wild. I bought a new capsule without my mom's permission...

544.original: Hey, check this out! A new capsule! This is so cool!

545.original: I wanna buy a new capsule... But my mom will be mad at me if I buy one without her permission.

546.original:
Are you using the accessories you have? There are some really awesome ones out there!

One of them makes all your skills cost only one Ki point! You'd be an unstoppable skill machine!

547.original: Wow... before I realized it, I wrote all over this thing. What to do, what to do...?

548.original:
No... parking! There! That'll be perfect!

Oh, wait... I better write You're in the way, too. That'll work.

549.original: I hate it when people park their cars here... think I'll draw some graffiti on it.

550.original:
T-they got East City...is this place next?!

I'm so scared...! What am I gonna do?! I'm really, really scared!

551.original: I'm a lady from the city, you know! I'm not like you country bumpkins!

552.original: Hey, those are some weird clothes you got, man! You from the sticks, or what?

553.original: The frosted glass prevents you from looking inside.

554.original: A note is written on the end of the car: No Graffiti!

555.original:
I lost so much weight, and now look... I'm heartbroken.

It's no good... the pizza killed me. That and the potato chips too, I guess.

556.original:
M-man, I've been walking a while... I'm giving it everything I got!

I musta lost a lot of weight by this point, huh? Now it's okay to start eating pizza again, right?

557.original: I-I'm so hot... I thought I'd go walk in heavy clothes to jump-start my metabolism...

558.original:
Press the X Button for the top row line, Y Button for the middle line, and B Button for the bottom line, right when the enemy attacks to execute an Active Guard.

If you get it right, you'll earn more resistance against Poison and things. It's worth trying out.

560.original: Whisper whisper whisper! Whisper whisper whisper whisper!

562.original:
You heard about the East City explosion? I bet the villains in this house were behind it!

I pretty sure that's got to be it! I'm positive!

563.original: What a weird house! I bet some villain lives in there! It's gotta be packed with bad guys!

564.original: This house is suspicious, if you ask me! I hear weird animal sounds out of it all day!

565.original: Boy, it sure is hard to stop emitting carbon dioxide. I just can't do it!

566.original:
I'm sick of going out on drives! We need to think more about the environment now!

We need to stop emitting carbon dioxide, and stuff like that!

567.original: I'm bored... I wish someone would take me on a drive or something.

568.original: I heard there was a terrorist attack on East City. Places like these, though... they're way safer.

569.original:
There's someone in Old City who just loves carrots.

If you've got one, why don't you pay him a visit?

570.original: Old City is just down those stairs. It's not very safe there, so be careful.

574.original:
Um, what's the sound that regular dogs make?

Was it Dog! Dog dog dog dog!

I'm pretty sure that was it.

577.original: It's not very nice to go peeping into people's homes.

578.original:
A sign on the door reads Coro.

It must be a doghouse.

579.original: I can't take it anymore! My eyes are spinning! I feel so... blorrff!

580.original: Oh man... it's all over... I can't control myself anymore...

581.original: I'm sure envious of these kids... heh heh.

582.original: How many laps have we done by now, anyway?

585.original: How many times have we gotten dizzy and fallen over by now, anyway?

588.original:
It's Lait-Lait! Would you like some coffee?

Um... is that Lait-Lait something you put in the coffee?

Oh, ewwwww! I don't even want to know what it is!

589.original:
Maybe the maid thing didn't work out, but this next will for sure! It's Lait-Lait Coffee!

Um, I have no idea what that means...

Besides, that sounds like the name of a panda or something.

590.original:
Just quit it, okay? You have no business sense!

I do too! There's gonna be a maid cafe next! It's gonna happen, I swear!

591.original:
I saw these huge shooting stars headed eastward!

Those must be what blew up East City! That's got to be it!

592.original: Boy, am I busy. I've got no time to clean, even. I wish someone could do it for me.

593.original: What? Hey, you're free, aren't you? Could you pick up some of this garbage?

597.original: We're hearing rumors about East City, too. It all smells pretty fishy to us!

598.original: People better start noticing soon. That guy is just gonna pop sooner or later.

599.original: That guy's so weird... always going on about this crazy stuff. I can just tell he's trouble.

605.original:
I just love carrots... All the world's a paradise as long as I have carrots...

If you find any carrots, please bring them back to me...

I've got some great stuff for you... I'm serious here...

606.original: Give him all the carrots you have?

607.original: This makes %d carrots you've given me in all.

608.original: Ah...! You brought carrots for me. You can have this in exchange. Thanks for coming through for me.

609.original:
A hundred carrots! You've given me over a hundred carrots!

Ahh...how wonderful... You've got to take this... It's a token of my gratitude...

610.original:
Whoa... Five hundred!

500 carrots...! You've given me 500 of them!

I just don't know what to say... Take this, okay? It's a token of my thanks.

611.original:
I can't believe it...! I just can't!

You've given me 1000 carrots! A full thousand!

Isn't it beautiful? You're so wonderful to me... Thank you so much...!

This is the greatest gift I can give you... Thank you! Oh, thank you!

612.original:
Um... could I ask you for 1000 carrots? Would that be too hard...?

If you can get those, I'll give you the key to a certain place...

A place where a legendary item lies in rest, waiting to be found. You curious yet...?

613.original: I really want 500 carrots... Get me those, and you'll get an item that'll make you richer.

614.original:
You know... I'd really like to have at least 100 of these...

Get me those, and I'll give you an item that makes it easier to run from enemies...

618.original: The door is boarded shut. It must have gone out of business.

619.original:
You can hear voices whispering inside...

Accuracy is pretty important... I guess you need to land attacks for them to mean anything, huh?

621.original: A sickly-sweet smell emanates from the other side of the door.

622.original: Oh! Perfect! I was just thinking about giving this to you.

625.original: Ooh, here's the newlywed now! Congratulations! I'm so jealous!

626.original: Who coulda guessed Goku would get married, huh? What a crazy world this is!

627.original:
The Earth's in a life-or-death struggle right now, and nobody even has a clue...

Sure feels weird, doesn't it?

628.original:
Don't you think the owner ought to say hi to us? We've been living here a while now.

Well, yeah! I think it's about time he did!

629.original:
Ahh, life is so easy in here! You think we can take this car, too?

Oh, of course! Look at how many they've got! Let's hop in!

630.original:
This house is huge! We could live here, and nobody'd ever notice!

Oh, totally! You wanna do it? Yeah, let's do it!

631.original:
Welcome, guest.

What, do you want to leave?

Do I look like your servant? Forget it.

632.original:
Welcome, guest.

What are you here for? If you do not have a problem to discuss, do not bother me.

633.original:
Welcome. Are you a guest?

State your business now.

634.original:
The first automobile developed by Capsule Corporation.

Its charming design has earned it a legion of fans even today.

635.original: The first mass-produced anti-gravity scooter, the result of a lifelong dream.

636.original: The latest light airplane, capable of vertical takeoff and landing. Anyone can pilot it.

637.original:
Boy, East City is in bad shape! I don't know any details, but it's in real bad shape!

If it's anything like how I am without any makeup, then it must be simply horrible!

638.original:
Bulma never comes back home these days.

Maybe she's become a delinquent! I bet that's it! Maybe I should join her in a gang or something!

639.original:
Well, nice to see you again! You're looking wonderful these days!

You people never bother seeing me. Honestly! I get lonely, you know!

640.original:
Well! You're a handsome one, aren't you?

Nice to meet you! I'm Bulma's mother!

642.original: Boy, I'm getting tired... Guess I'll have to sleep it off.

643.original: Ahhh, it's so warm... It's like heaven in here!

644.original:
Whoa!

Hey, I'm not a criminal or anything! I'm just shacking up here for a bit!

645.original: I swear, I'm not a criminal! Don't worry about me!

652.original:
......

......

Do you really care that much about me?

653.original:
......

......

You just don't give up, do you?

659.original:
My concern now lies with my companions that live in East City...

I am safe simply because I happened to be here. It is nothing but pure, simple luck.

What can I do for all of them? That is all I can think about, every day...

660.original:
Everyone here is basking in their good fortune as if they were entitled to it.

A single stroke of luck, and they could have been on the other side of this window.

When I think about that, I can't help but feel awkward...

661.original:
The place we are in right now is a safe, clean, and comfortable environment.

I am unable to hide the joy I feel to be free from hunger and permitted to run free.

Wahoooo!!

665.original: Some skills cannot be learned right off the bat... Try to experiment a little.

666.original: The West City skyline is laid out beyond the window.

667.original: They found an alien spaceship in East City, didn't they? Man, I'd love to see it!

668.original: It's always nothing but men in your group. Why don'tcha hang out with girls a little more, huh?

669.original: Hey! You doing okay? I'm fit as a fiddle! Ha ha ha!

670.original: Ah, a visitor! What would you like to see? My private dirty book stash is right here!

671.original:
One bolt's screwed in, two go missing...

Two bolts are screwed in, four go missing...

I think I'm gonna have a screw loose myself before too long.

672.original:
I'm not done yet...! I can do this!

All I gotta do is follow the steps in this manual!

I can do it! I can change myself! Yes I can!

673.original:
So this connects to this... and that connects to over there...

Dahh, I don't get this at all! How does this thing work?!

677.original: An airplane? A submarine? A spaceship? This could be anything, really.

678.original: The cluttered bookshelf is filled with nothing but dirty books.

679.original: A model made of rigid clay. This must be how they finalize their designs.

680.original: Someone is halfway done building an airplane model on this desk. There's parts everywhere.

682.original: Your way is blocked by a gigantic clump of ice.
